posts_count.source: PicMany snapshot on 17 Nov 2026 reported 172 posts (trends/brief.md). The mockup header shows 172 plus the 9 new-post slots when the toggle is on. The existing grid tiles are catalog stand-ins until real top-row screenshots land in strategy/ref/ig_grid/.

highlights.source: Highlight NAMES (Factory, Furniture, Exhibitions, Projects) were observed in a PicMany public snapshot of @inhouz.in on 17 Nov 2026. Highlight COVER IMAGES are stand-ins cropped from INHOUZ_collection.pdf product photography — the real highlight artwork was not available. Instagram itself was not opened while logged in.

existing_posts.source: Real Instagram post thumbnails were not available (no Instagram session). products/ was empty. strategy/ref/ig_grid/ is watched: when grid screenshots land, they are cropped into tiles and replace these stand-ins. Until then the grid uses 12 square-cropped product shots from INHOUZ_collection.pdf. strategy/ref/profile_pic.jpg is a low-resolution brand mark (150×150, 2 KB), lower quality than the catalog-cover avatar, so it was not used. The x_*.jpg files are X/Twitter crossposts, not the current Instagram grid, so they were left as reference only rather than presented as existing IG posts. Captions, like counts and comments on stand-in tiles are catalog-derived placeholder text.

likes_and_comments.source: All like counts and comments are static placeholder text for the detail view. There is no input, no submission, and no data collection.

planned_posts.source: Grid order is post 1 at top-left through post 9. Post types are taken from posts/manifest.md when that file exists. Otherwise every new post defaults to a 4:5 still (1080×1350), shown as a centre-cropped square tile and 4:5 in the detail view. Multiple stills that share a post number are grouped as one swipeable carousel. Reel and mp4 playback are used only when the manifest explicitly marks a post as a Reel. strategy/plan.md is not used for post types. Captions in captions/post-01_… to post-09_… are matched by post number.
